name: San Francisco Diaper Bank
description: Free diapers for CalFresh, Medi-Cal, and CalWORKs households with children under age two (up to two cases per child/month)
fullDescription: The San Francisco Diaper Bank, a partnership between SFHSA and the nonprofit Help a Mother Out, provides free monthly diapers for children under age two to San Francisco residents who receive Medi-Cal, CalWORKs, or CalFresh. Participating does not reduce your food or cash benefits.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free diapers for eligible families
- For children under age two
- Up to two cases per child/month
- Available to CalFresh recipients
- Available to Medi-Cal recipients
- Available to CalWORKs (and Cal-Learn) households
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a San Francisco resident enrolled in CalFresh, Medi-Cal, or CalWORKs
2. Child must be under age two
3. Go to an SFHSA Service Center (1440 Harrison St, 170 Otis St, 3120 Mission St, or 1460 Mission St) or a partner family resource center
4. Bring your EBT or BIC card and a valid government-issued ID
5. Someone else can pick up for you with an SFDB Designee Form
6. Pick up your monthly allotment
keywords: SF Diaper Bank, free diapers, under age two, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, CalWORKs, baby supplies, two cases
